messages:
Maya SRE: Quick postmortem follow-up — three p95 latency spikes for text-gen in us-west over 6 days. Need owners + timeline for remediation, and an emergency SLO adjustment to prevent customer impact.

Dan Smith: I looked at traces. KV-cache eviction storms coincide with the tails; large request batches make it worse. I can own dashboard panels and alert tuning.

Rachel P: Error-budget is getting eaten. If this continues, we should pause noncritical rollouts and consider a short SLO override.

Priya Anand: I'll take kvcache eviction tuning (ETA Tue EOD). Can @Dan Smith add per-pool p95 panels by Mon noon?

Dan Smith: Yup. Grafana p95-by-pool query I'll add: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le, pool)).

ops-bot: Created RED-7812 "us-west text-gen p95 spike remediations".

Maya SRE: Drafted emergency SLO override for ops runbook: bump p95 target + 24h window and auto-rollback if extra budget burn >5%. PR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/1291

Rachel P: Also request an alert: sustained p95 delta >30ms for 15m -> page oncall with runbook link. We miss nighttime regressions.

Dan Smith: Added alert + panels. Posting links in the ticket.

Priya Anand: Plan recap: Priya -> kvcache tuning (Tue EOD), Dan -> dashboards/alerts (Mon noon), Maya -> SLO override PR + gating (today). Reconvene Wed 10am to review telemetry and decide on permanent SLO edits.

Maya SRE: If spikes persist after tuning we'll throttle large batches and apply per-pool quotas. Action items captured in RED-7812.
